{"notes": "Visit 4 (7:00). Nobody spoke while I was there. Table: the nose joint has caught. The top line is now dark from start through the nose to the tail (x~27, y~5), and the bottom line is dark to its tail (x~27, y~15). Both lines are connected and spacing and curves are still neat. One small pale stub (x~7.5-9, y~7.5-9) is left beside the nose, probably an abandoned or misaligned first link attempt. It is not connected, so it's harmless unless it's in the way of the push. The picture shows the result, but I still don't know who placed or fixed what, so I'm giving no placement credit from it.

Priya: Her 3:30 claim that the nose was hooked in was premature, but it's now true. I can't confirm she did the fix. Her testing instinct is good. Judge her on whether she owns the correction, so ask her what changed.

Tom: Earlier he was accurate and honest, and he offered to help with the joint. The fix plausibly came from him and Priya, but I didn't see it. Keep him as solid on collaboration and execution, unconfirmed on this fix.

Maya: Silent again. Bottom line finished, so she probably delivered on pace, but I can't verify who built it. Credit tentatively.

Leo: Still nothing seen or heard in four visits. No evidence of impact. Don't penalize without information. Ask him privately what he did, and ask the others about it too.

Next: Does the run topple end to end? Ask each person privately who fixed the nose and who built what."}
